signals.name: ACLK
signals.description: Global clock signal. All signals are sampled on the rising edge.

signals.name: ARESETn
signals.description: Global reset signal. Active-LOW.

signals.name: AWID
signals.description: Write address ID. Identifies the write transaction.

signals.name: AWADDR
signals.description: Write address. The starting physical address for a write burst.

signals.name: AWLEN
signals.description: Burst length. The exact number of transfers in a burst is AWLEN + 1.

signals.name: AWSIZE
signals.description: Burst size. The size of each transfer in the burst (e.g., 0b010 = 4 bytes).

signals.name: AWBURST
signals.description: Burst type. Indicates FIXED, INCR, or WRAP.

signals.name: AWVALID
signals.description: Write address valid. Indicates that valid write address and control information are available.

signals.name: AWREADY
signals.description: Write address ready. Indicates that the slave is ready to accept an address and associated control signals.

signals.name: WDATA
signals.description: Write data.

signals.name: WSTRB
signals.description: Write strobes. Indicates which byte lanes hold valid data.

signals.name: WLAST
signals.description: Write last. Indicates the last transfer in a write burst.

signals.name: WVALID
signals.description: Write valid. Indicates that valid write data and strobes are available.

signals.name: WREADY
signals.description: Write ready. Indicates that the slave can accept the write data.

signals.name: BID
signals.description: Response ID tag. Must match the AWID of the transaction to which the slave is responding.

signals.name: BRESP
signals.description: Write response. Indicates OKAY, EXOKAY, SLVERR, or DECERR.

signals.name: BVALID
signals.description: Write response valid. Indicates that the channel is signaling a valid write response.

signals.name: BREADY
signals.description: Response ready. Indicates that the master can accept a write response.

signals.name: ARID
signals.description: Read address ID. Identifies the read transaction.

signals.name: ARADDR
signals.description: Read address. The starting physical address for a read burst.

signals.name: ARLEN
signals.description: Burst length. The exact number of transfers in a burst is ARLEN + 1.

signals.name: ARSIZE
signals.description: Burst size. The size of each transfer in the burst (e.g., 0b010 = 4 bytes).

signals.name: ARBURST
signals.description: Burst type. Indicates FIXED, INCR, or WRAP.

signals.name: ARVALID
signals.description: Read address valid. Indicates that valid read address and control information are available.

signals.name: ARREADY
signals.description: Read address ready. Indicates that the slave is ready to accept an address and associated control signals.

signals.name: RID
signals.description: Read ID tag. Must match the ARID of the read transaction.

signals.name: RDATA
signals.description: Read data.

signals.name: RRESP
signals.description: Read response. Indicates OKAY, EXOKAY, SLVERR, or DECERR.

signals.name: RLAST
signals.description: Read last. Indicates the last transfer in a read burst.

signals.name: RVALID
signals.description: Read valid. Indicates that the channel is signaling the required read data.

signals.name: RREADY
signals.description: Read ready. Indicates that the master can accept the read data and response information.
